svg.text: One program, 46 languages — does GitGalaxy read it the same everywhere?
Identical planted code in every language. Each dot is one language's deviation from the cross-language median: green ±25%, amber ±50%, red beyond.
Rows run best → worst inside each group. Every dot outside the green band has a verdict in the deviation ledger; an unexplained one is drawn as a red ring.
